name: unit
meaning: Shipped, with its logic tested against stubbed HTTP. Never run against a real instance.
localMeaning: Shipped, with its logic tested against a stubbed git, and its parsers checked once against the real git in a scratch repository.

name: live
meaning: Run against a real instance; its common commands work there.

name: stable
meaning: In routine use against real instances, with its commands and output settled.
